column1: Adds 41 traditional ceramic glaze colors and 123 colored bricks. Fire minerals, ash, bone or precious metal nuggets into bagged glaze powders at the kiln or magma kiln, then blend powders for secondary colors. Making and mixing glaze needs no fuel; firing it onto pottery or brick does. Vanilla offered two glazes, ash and tin.
column2: 添加 41 种传统陶瓷釉色与 123 种彩色陶砖。在黏土窑或岩浆黏土窑中，将矿物、灰、骨头或贵金属矿块制成袋装釉粉，再混合釉粉调出新颜色。制作与混合釉料不需要燃料，将釉料烧附在陶器或陶砖上需要燃料。原版只有灰釉与锡釉两种。

column1: Vanilla Dwarf Fortress gives you two glazes - ash and tin. Even legendary glazers had to limit their masterworks to two colors. Every jug, every pot, even the statues of great figures of history were only either cream or green. Better Glazing gives you forty-one, drawn from the metal oxides real potters have used for a thousand years. It puts new value on old stones. Grind cobaltite for deep blue, pyrolusite for plum, microcline for jade green, pitchblende for fiestaware orange and rock salt for gray. Fire ten bones down to bone ash white. Melt a native gold nugget into lustreware, the most valuable glaze a dwarf can aspire to ring their pots in. Then mix bag against bag. Cobalt into copper gives you teal. Iron red softened with tin white gives you rose. Chrome and tin, the old potter's trick, gives you pink. Two full bags out of every blend, in a color neither parent had. Every glaze is a bagged powder that wears its own color in the stockpile, so you always know what you are about to fire. Three glazed items to a bag. No fuel to make it or to mix it. All jobs work in both kilns and magma kilns. They are the glazing jobs your potters already know. And it does not stop at pottery. Fire glaze onto earthenware, stoneware or porcelain and you have 123 colored bricks, for walls and floors and towers that hold their color as long as the fortress stands. Two colors were never enough. You have forty-one. Build something worth looking at.
column2: 原版《矮人要塞》只有灰釉和锡釉两种釉料。即便是传奇上釉工匠，也只能用两种颜色打造杰作：每个陶壶、每口陶罐，甚至历史伟人的雕像，都只能是奶油色或绿色。“缤纷釉彩”带来 41 种釉色，取材于现实陶工使用了上千年的金属氧化物，让旧石材焕发新价值。研磨辉钴矿可得深蓝色，软锰矿可得李紫色，微斜长石可得翡翠绿色，沥青铀矿可得费斯塔陶器般的橙色，岩盐可得灰色。烧制十块骨头可得白色骨灰釉，熔化天然金矿块可制成金属光泽釉，这是矮人能用来装点陶罐的最珍贵釉料。然后，将两袋釉粉混合：钴蓝与铜绿调成蓝绿色，铁红以锡白柔化便得到玫瑰色，铬与锡结合则得到粉红色，这是老陶工的秘技。每次混合得到两整袋釉粉，颜色不同于任一原料。所有釉料都是袋装粉末，在储存堆中呈现自己的颜色，让你清楚即将烧制的釉色。一袋能为三件物品上釉，制作与混合均不需要燃料。所有作业都适用于黏土窑和岩浆黏土窑，仍使用陶工熟悉的上釉流程。用途也不限于陶器：将釉料烧附在瓦陶、炻瓷或瓷器上，就得到 123 种彩色陶砖，可建造墙壁、地面与高塔；只要要塞屹立，颜色便永不褪去。两种颜色从来不够。现在你有 41 种，建造些值得欣赏的作品吧。

column1: Fire raw materials into colored glaze powder. One dose glazes one item; a full bag holds three.
column2: 将原料制成彩色釉粉。一份可为一件物品上釉，一整袋包含三份。

column1: Blend a full bag of each parent color into two full bags of the result. Needs two empty bags.
column2: 各取一整袋原色釉粉，混合成两整袋新色釉粉。需要两个空袋。

column1: Fuse a glaze onto plain earthenware bricks. A colored brick keeps its color when built into a wall, which a glazed item cannot.
column2: 将釉料烧附在普通瓦陶砖上。彩色砖建成墙壁后仍保留颜色，上釉物品则无法做到。
